name: La Fortaleza and San Juan National Historic Site in Puerto Rico
description: Perched on the edge of Old San Juan, this cluster of Spanish forts and city walls guarded the Caribbean's key harbour entrance for centuries. Its massive stone ramparts, including La Fortaleza, which still serves as the governor's residence, rank among the oldest and largest European-built defences in the Western Hemisphere. Visitors can walk the fortifications and take in sweeping views over the bay.
